cohort: 3293 nulliparous women delivering singletons at ≥24 weeks gestation
finding: While infertility was initially associated with increased cesarean delivery risk, this association was attributed to maternal age, with infertility remaining independently associated with earlier gestational age at delivery.
mod_finding: Infertile women were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery in the bivariate analysis, but this association was no longer significant after adjusting for maternal age.
